title: CISSP® Certification (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
body: International Information System Security Certification Consortium (ISC)²
source: ISC2 CISSP Common Body of Knowledge (CBK 2024-2026)
summary: The premier global cybersecurity engineering and security architecture credential covering 8 Common Body of Knowledge (CBK) domains, an adaptive CAT examination (100-150 items), and 5 years verified experience.

standard.name: Standard CISSP Pathway
standard.blurb: Master the 8 CBK domains, pass the 3-hour Computerized Adaptive Testing (CAT) exam (700/1000 passing score), and obtain professional endorsement.

stages.title: Stage 1: Security Governance, Asset Protection & Architecture
stages.subtitle: Domains 1 through 4: Risk, Assets, Architecture, and Networks

nodes.name: Domain 1: Security and Risk Management
nodes.description: ISC2 Code of Ethics, confidentiality/integrity/availability, security governance, compliance/legal regulations (GDPR/HIPAA), business continuity (BCP), and risk management quantitative formulas (ALE, SLE, ARO).
topics: ISC2 Code of Professional Ethics (4 Mandatory Canons)
CIA Triad, Non-Repudiation, and Defense-in-Depth Principles
Legal & Regulatory Compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, Sarbanes-Oxley)
Business Continuity Planning (BCP) & Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
Quantitative & Qualitative Risk Assessment (SLE = AV × EF; ALE = SLE × ARO)

nodes.name: Domain 2: Asset Security
nodes.description: Information and asset classification, privacy management, data lifecycles, data ownership roles (Owners, Custodians), retention policies, and cryptographic data states (in transit, at rest, in use).
topics: Commercial vs Government Data Classification Schemes
Data Ownership, Custodianship & Data Protection Officers (DPO)
Protecting Data States: At Rest (AES-256), In Transit (TLS 1.3), In Use (Enclaves)
Data Sanitization: Clearing, Purging, Degaussing, and Destruction

nodes.name: Domain 3: Security Architecture and Engineering
nodes.description: Security engineering models (Bell-LaPadula, Biba), security capabilities of systems (memory protection, TPM), modern cryptography (symmetric, asymmetric, hashing, post-quantum), and physical security.
topics: Formal Security Models: Bell-LaPadula (Confidentiality) & Biba (Integrity)
Cryptographic Algorithms: AES, RSA, ECC, SHA-256, and Digital Signatures
Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) & Certificate Authorities (CA)
Physical Facility Security: CPTED, Access Controls, HVAC, and Fire Suppression

nodes.name: Domain 4: Communication and Network Security
nodes.description: OSI and TCP/IP models, secure network architecture, software-defined networking (SDN), micro-segmentation, wireless security (WPA3), cellular protocols, and remote access VPNs.
topics: OSI 7-Layer Architecture & TCP/IP Protocol Security Vulnerabilities
Network Security Appliances: Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), IDS/IPS, Proxies
Software-Defined Networking (SDN) & Micro-Segmentation
Wireless Security (WPA3 Enterprise) & Secure Remote Access (IPsec/WireGuard)

stages.title: Stage 2: Identity, Testing, Operations & Software Security
stages.subtitle: Domains 5 through 8: IAM, Assessment, Security Ops, and DevSecOps

nodes.name: Domain 5: Identity and Access Management (IAM)
nodes.description: Identification, authentication, authorization, accountability; federated identity (SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC), multi-factor authentication (MFA), biometric factors, and role-based access control (RBAC).
topics: Identification, Authentication, Authorization & Accounting (AAA)
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) & Biometric Error Rates (CER/EER)
Federated Identity Management: SAML, OpenID Connect (OIDC), OAuth 2.0
Access Control Schemes: Discretionary (DAC), Mandatory (MAC), Role-Based (RBAC), Attribute-Based (ABAC)

nodes.name: Domain 6: Security Assessment and Testing
nodes.description: Vulnerability assessment, penetration testing methodologies, security audits, code reviews (SAST/DAST), synthetic transaction testing, and third-party assurance evaluations (SOC reports).
topics: Vulnerability Scanning vs Penetration Testing (Black, White, Gray Box)
Security Testing Methodologies: SAST, DAST, IAST, and Fuzzing
Third-Party Vendor Assessments & SOC 2 Type II Evaluation
Disaster Recovery Testing (Walkthrough, Simulation, Parallel, Full Interruption)

nodes.name: Domain 7: Security Operations
nodes.description: Investigations and digital forensics (chain of custody), logging/SIEM/SOAR monitoring, incident management lifecycle, disaster recovery operations, and physical facility security.
topics: Digital Forensics Evidence Acquisition, Admissibility & Chain of Custody
Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) & SOAR Automation
Incident Handling Phases: Detection, Containment, Eradication, Recovery, Lessons Learned
Patch Management, Vulnerability Management & Endpoint Detection (EDR/XDR)

nodes.name: Domain 8: Software Development Security
nodes.description: Secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities (SQLi, XSS, SSRF), threat modeling (STRIDE), APIs, software supply chain security, and DevSecOps pipelines.
topics: Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) & DevSecOps Pipelines
OWASP Top 10 Vulnerabilities: Injection, Broken Auth, XSS, SSRF, Deserialization
Threat Modeling Frameworks: STRIDE, PASTA, and Attack Trees
Software Supply Chain Security, SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) & Open-Source Governance

stages.title: Stage 3: Examination, Endorsement & Charter Conferred
stages.subtitle: Computerized Adaptive Testing (CAT), 5 years experience endorsement, and credential award

nodes.name: CISSP Computerized Adaptive Examination (CAT)
nodes.frequency: Continuous CBT testing globally via Pearson VUE
nodes.description: Variable-length adaptive computer test evaluating the 8 CBK domains. Minimum passing competence: scaled score of 700 out of 1000 points.
checklists: Achieve scaled score of at least 700 out of 1000
Answer minimum 100 questions within the 3-hour limit

nodes.name: 5 Years Verified Professional Security Experience
nodes.description: Demonstrate at least 5 years of cumulative, paid full-time work experience in two or more of the 8 CISSP CBK domains (1-year waiver available for Bachelor's degree or approved credentials).
topics: 5-Year Work Verification in 2+ Domains
1-Year Academic/Credential Waiver

nodes.name: Professional Endorsement & Code of Ethics
nodes.description: Obtain formal endorsement by an active (ISC)² certified professional in good standing, attest to the ISC2 Code of Ethics, and receive the CISSP charter.
topics: Active ISC2 Member Endorsement Sign-Off
ISC2 Code of Ethics Preamble & Canons Commitment
Annual 40 CPE Maintenance Requirement
